### Observed differences

- A02 participation dropped from about 32% to 10% of traces; its mean occurrences per trace fell from 0.33 to 0.11. [OCC001]
- A06 participation rose from 3% to 12%. [OCC002]
- A25's outgoing transitions changed from a spread over A41, A42, A35, A43, A36 (each ~18–22%) to almost exclusively A27 (99%). [DIR003]
- A26's outgoing transitions changed from A30 (98%) to a spread over A35, A42, A41, A43, A36 (each ~16–21%). [DIR004]
- For A35, A36, A41, A42, A43, the successor A27 (previously ~17–22%) was replaced by A30 (now ~18–21%). [DIR005–DIR009]
- A46's successor A02 dropped from 28% to 1%, while A19 and A20 increased. [DIR010]
- A26 and A27 moved earlier (mean position from 0.65 to 0.52 and 0.52 to 0.39), while A35, A36, A41, A42, A43 moved later (mean from ~0.44 to ~0.60). [POS002–POS008]
- A02 co-occurrence with many activities dropped from 31.5% to 10%, and the order reversed from A02 before them to them before A02. [REL001–REL010]
- A26 and A27 now occur before A35, A36, A41, A42, A43, whereas before they occurred after them. [REL011–REL020]
- A46 is now closer to A19, A20, A25 (lag distances decreased). [LAG020–LAG022]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports a change in the ordering and routing of activities: A26 and A27 moved earlier relative to a group of activities (A35, A36, A41, A42, A43), and the successor of A25 changed from that group to A27, while A26's successor changed from A30 to that group. This is directly shown by the reversal of order between A26/A27 and the group (REL011–REL020) and by the position shifts (POS002–POS008), as well as by the successor changes (DIR003–DIR009). Additionally, A02 participation dropped sharply, and A06 increased.

Other differences: A46's successor changed from A02 to A19/A20, and A46 became closer to A19, A20, A25. A06 increased in participation.

A competing explanation that cannot be fully ruled out is that some of the changes reflect sampling variation in rare activities (e.g., A02 after only 20 traces, many LAG items have very low after support), but the core reordering is supported by items with full support.
